snippet.title: Retail Hell - Official Demo Trailer | The MIX | Kinda Funny Spring Game Showcase
snippet.description: Meet the nightmare customer. Watch the latest Retail Hell trailer for this upcoming horror job simulator game. Trapped in an infinite shift, you are the sole clerk of purgatory’s only convenience store. Manage stock, pay your taxes and keep nightmarish creatures at bay as you uncover the secret of why your shift never ends. Clock in. Serve the dead. Survive the shift. Retail will be available on PC in Spring 2026, and a demo is out now on Steam.
